problem.headline: Every Second Counts During a Stroke
problem.subheadline: One of the biggest dangers during a stroke is lost time. Many patients do not receive medical help quickly enough due to delayed communication and unrecognized symptoms.
problem.card1_desc: Family members are not informed immediately when their loved one experiences an emergency, delaying critical decisions.
problem.card2_desc: Emergency services are often contacted too late, severely reducing the chances of a successful recovery.
problem.card3_desc: Warning signs are frequently misunderstood or ignored, preventing patients from receiving the immediate medical help they need.
problem.card4_desc: A stroke can strike suddenly, leaving the patient physically unable to call for help or explain their situation alone.
problem.stat1: brain cells die every minute during an untreated stroke
problem.stat2: of strokes are preventable with proper tracking and awareness
problem.stat3: faster emergency response significantly improves recovery chances

faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheadline: Everything you need to know about AVCARE.
faq.q1: Is AVCARE safe to use for medical purposes?
faq.a1: Yes. AVCARE is developed with healthcare professionals and follows strict medical privacy standards. It is a support tool that complements professional medical care.
faq.q2: In which languages is the app available?
faq.a2: AVCARE is fully available in English, French, and Arabic, with right-to-left support for Arabic users.
faq.a3: Yes. AVCARE is developed with the Algerian healthcare context in mind and is optimized for use in Algeria. An APK download is available for Android devices.
faq.q4: How is my health data protected?
faq.a4: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never share your personal health information with third parties. Your privacy is our top priority.
faq.q5: Can doctors and family members access my data?
faq.a5: Only people you explicitly invite to your care circle can access your data. You remain in full control of your health information at all times.
faq.q6: Does AVCARE require an internet connection?
faq.a6: Emergency alerts require an internet connection. However, calling the green number does not require internet.
faq.a7: AVCARE is free to download. Premium features for healthcare providers may require a subscription in the future.
